volunteerExperiences.companyName: Code in Place, offered online by Stanford University (2020 and 2021 editions)
volunteerExperiences.description:
Part of a teaching team for Code in Place, offered by Stanford during COVID-19 pandemic, with 10,000 global students and 900 volunteer teachers participating from around the world.

Prepared and taught a weekly discussion section of 10-12 students to supplement professors’ lectures in a 5-week introductory online Python programming course based on material from the first half of Stanford’s introductory programming course, CS106A.

company.name: Code in Place, offered online by Stanford University (2020 and 2021 editions)

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Mountain View Spanish Language Civic Leadership Academy
volunteerExperiences.description:
2017 First generation member of the Mountain View Civic Leadership Academy, a 10 week program that educates residents in the functioning of city government and services.
As a hispanic in a position of privilege, I've been using my skills and resources to
1) Perform direct actions that attempt to help the vulnerable communities of our city
2) Help raise awareness and become a liaison with city government to better help our vulnerable communities  

Creator and administrator of http://www.mvlideres.org

company.name: Mountain View Spanish Language Civic Leadership Academy
